entries.240542764ef7fc24: This reportable segment conducts power generation and electricity sales and integrated energy supply businesses on an integrated basis. It is the largest of the three reportable segments, with revenue from external customers of ¥1,201,930 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026. Revenue decreased from the previous year, due to a decrease in the fuel cost adjustment amount resulting from lower fuel prices, although retail electricity sales volume increased. Power generation comes from hydro, thermal, nuclear, new energy and other sources, and sales are divided between retail sales of lighting and power and sales to other companies. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, Shimane Nuclear Power Plant Unit 2 came into operation, and nuclear power generation volume significantly exceeded the previous year.
entries.59e56dc5012c2136: This reportable segment conducts telecommunications-related business and other operations. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥34,005 million. Revenue increased from the previous year, due to higher commission revenue in telecommunications-related business and the acquisition of new customers. This is the only one of the three reportable segments whose revenue increased from the previous year.

entries.cbba2f2f7af7642f: This reportable segment conducts general transmission and distribution business and related operations, undertaken by Chugoku Denryoku Network Co., Ltd. The company's general transmission and distribution business and related operations were transferred to that company in April 2020. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥176,903 million. Revenue decreased from the previous year, due to a decrease in standard connection wheeling revenue resulting from lower wheeling demand, although inter-operator settlement revenue increased from electricity sales to other areas.
